recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy composition featuring two young male performers mid-air against a textured white studio background, anchored by a central distressed typographic logo and a bottom black metadata bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical dynamic action with subjects jumping outward from the center
Contrast between clean white background and gritty, distressed graphic elements
Visual connection via a long microphone cable looping through the negative space
Hierarchy established by the central logo placement between the two subjects
coreInvariants: High-key studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body subjects at medium-large scale, positioned on the left and right thirds, captured in mid-jump.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central logo stack and the orange splatter graphic serve as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central logo outward to the expressive faces of the performers, then follow the microphone cable loop.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space with subtle vertical texture/pinstriping to emphasize the subjects' motion.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background) and Blue (denim jeans) provide the primary canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (typography, footer, and shadows) provides structural definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange (splatter graphic) adds a pop of energy and brand recognition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with moderately saturated clothing and a high-saturation accent graphic.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon colors except for the specific orange accent

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges suggesting a stamp or stencil effect
Tight vertical stacking with minimal leading
Slightly irregular baseline for a 'garage band' feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are contained within or overlapping dark, rectangular distressed blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact distressed display type paired with a casual, friendly monoline script for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Microphone cable as a framing device

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy condensed weight and blocky feel
Captures the eroded edges and DIY aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image of two young boys with shaggy hair jumping excitedly. One on the left holds drumsticks; one on the right holds a vintage microphone with a long black cable. They wear casual clothes (white blazer/red shirt and open blue shirt/white tank) with denim jeans. Background is bright white with subtle vertical grey pinstripe texture. Leave the center-right area open for a logo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-line stacked title in a heavy, distressed white sans-serif font. Place each line inside a black, weathered rectangular box. Position an orange organic splatter shape behind the top-left of the text. Add a solid black bar at the very bottom with small white handwritten-style text centered inside.

verificationChecks: Is the text stacked in three distinct lines?
Does the typography have a weathered, stamped texture?
Is the orange splatter positioned behind the logo?
Is there a black footer bar at the bottom?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the microphone cable creates a fluid loop in the composition.
Check that the distressed text is still legible.
Verify the subjects appear to be at the same height/scale.
Confirm the bottom black bar is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dynamic Action + High-Key Background + Distressed Block Typography + Brand Color Splatter
